messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up thread — compiling action items from the LB/DNS/TLS incident last night. I'll list owners + due dates, add if you disagree.
raj: Thanks — high level: regional LB routing bug caused cross-region TLS fallback and amplified retries. Need owners for fix, monitoring, and a short runbook.
sam: I'll own the SNI mapping config change for the regional routes. Target EOD 2026-04-07. I'll open a PR today.
devon: I'll take monitoring + runbook: add a synthetic probe for SNI mismatch and a metric for TLS handshake fail rate >0.5% over 5m. ETA 2026-04-05.
maria: Also need a runtime circuit-breaker for repeated egress retries (to avoid retry storms). @devon @sam can we coordinate on gating and canary?
devon: Yep. Proposed short plan:
- add alert + test probe
- publish runbook in #eng-oncall
- safe canary (10% traffic)
I'll draft the runbook and link it here.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 - includes SNI mapping and a couple of guardrails. Needs infra signoff from @judy before rollout.
judy: Reviewing PR now. On the DNS side, ops-bot spotted transient TTL inconsistencies across regions (us-east vs eu-west) that likely worsened failover behavior.
ops-bot: Alert: dns_ttl_mismatch detected prod-us-east -> prod-eu; sample log:
```
2026-03-20T23:45:12Z ERROR LB: SNI mismatch for host api.redwood.ai region=eu request_id=abc123
2026-03-20T23:45:13Z WARN  DNS: observed TTL=0.1s vs expected TTL=300s for zone redwood.ai
```
raj: For DNS remediation: owner @ashley to coordinate with registrar and edge-cache invalidation. Target complete by 2026-04-03.
ashley: Taking DNS owner. I'll schedule registrar record audit and run cache flush across edge nodes. ETA 2026-04-04.
maria: Long-term follow-up: we should add automated drift detection for edge DNS TTL differences and surface them in our network digest. Owner: @raj, design doc due 2026-04-15.
raj: Will pick that up. Also proposing a weekly "networking incident trend" digest to catch recurring retry/TLS patterns early. Owner: @maria, start cadence 2026-04-01.
maria: I'll own the digest and put a template in #eng-sre.
sam: One more action: routing policy change to prefer same-region endpoints when cert validation fails (so we avoid cross-region fallbacks causing higher latency/retries). Owner: @sam. ETA 2026-04-10.
devon: I'll add an SLO measurement for TLS handshake success rate and wire it to an auto-fallback threshold. ETA 2026-04-06.
maria: Summarizing action items:
- sam: fix SNI mapping PR and routing policy change (PR open -> rollout) (EOD 2026-04-07 / policy by 2026-04-10)
- devon: monitoring + synthetic probes + runbook (2026-04-05)
- ashley: registrar audit + edge cache invalidation (2026-04-04)
- raj: edge DNS TTL drift detection design doc (2026-04-15)
- maria: weekly networking incident digest (start 2026-04-01)
Please react :thumbsup: if items look right or reply with changes.
judy: :thumbsup:
ashley: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Created task N-452 in the incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/N-452
maria: I'll file this thread into the postmortem doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-lb-dns and close the loop once each task is marked done. Ping me to swap owners. Thanks all!
